description: How organisations make data trustworthy, lawful and useful: governance structures, master data, quality, privacy law, records, metadata and the oversight of analytics models. Students work SQL profiling and lineage exercises in the database engine and decide governance cases in the scenario engine.
modelledOn: DAMA International, DAMA-DMBOK: Data Management Body of Knowledge
Ladley, Data Governance: How to Design, Deploy and Sustain an Effective Data Governance Program
ISO 8000 data quality and ISO 15489 records management standards
outcomes: Design a data governance operating model with defined roles, policies, decision rights and maturity measures.
Apply master data and entity resolution techniques to build a golden record from conflicting sources.
Profile, measure and improve data quality with SQL rules, lineage tracing and issue management.
Assess a processing activity against the Ghanaian Data Protection Act and comparable African and international laws.
Build records retention, metadata catalogue and model risk controls proportionate to the risk of a dataset.

units.title: Data governance frameworks and roles
topics: Data as an asset: value, cost, risk and the knowledge areas of data management
Governance operating models: centralised, federated and hybrid
Roles: data owner, steward, custodian, protection officer and the governance council
Policies, standards, controls and decision rights; RACI charts
Maturity models and governance metrics
Data strategy and the business case for governance

units.title: Master and reference data management
topics: MDM implementation styles: registry, consolidation, coexistence and centralised hub
Golden records: matching rules and survivorship
Entity resolution: blocking, fuzzy string matching and thresholds
Reference data, code lists and hierarchies
National and organisational identifiers as master keys: lessons from national ID and health ID systems

units.title: Data quality and lineage
topics: Data quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness and validity
Data profiling with SQL: null rates, distinct counts, patterns and outliers
Quality rules, constraints and validation at the point of entry
Cleansing and deduplication workflows
Lineage: table-level and column-level lineage, impact analysis
Quality KPIs, issue management and root cause analysis

units.title: Privacy and data protection law
topics: Privacy principles: purpose limitation, minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation and accountability
Ghana's Data Protection Act and its regulator, compared with laws in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, the continental convention and the EU GDPR
Lawful basis, consent and data subject rights
Privacy impact assessments and privacy by design
De-identification: pseudonymisation, k-anonymity and the idea of differential privacy
Cross-border transfers and breach notification duties

units.title: Records and lifecycle management
topics: The data and information lifecycle from creation to disposal
Retention schedules, legal holds and regulatory minimums
Archiving, disposal and secure deletion
Records management principles and digital preservation
Storage tiers, backup versus archive and cost of keeping data

units.title: Metadata and data catalogues
topics: Business, technical and operational metadata
Data dictionaries and business glossaries
Catalogue architecture: harvesting, search and stewardship workflow
Classification and tagging by sensitivity
Metadata standards: Dublin Core, DCAT and the FAIR principles
Querying the database information schema to build a catalogue

units.title: Analytics governance and model risk
topics: Governing the analytics lifecycle: approval, deployment and monitoring
Model inventories, tiering and independent validation
Bias and fairness audits of automated decisions such as credit scoring
Explainability and documentation: model cards and datasheets for datasets
Responsible AI policy and emerging regulation
Data sharing agreements, open data and third-party data

units.title: Governance programme in practice
topics: Designing a governance programme for a bank, a hospital or a ministry
Access control and security classification: RBAC, ABAC and least privilege
Audit, compliance monitoring and regulator engagement
Roadmap, quick wins and presenting to an executive board

schedule.title: Why govern data, and who decides
schedule.exercise: Estimate the annual cost of poor data in a mid-size bank from duplicated customers and failed mobile money reconciliations, and propose who in the organisation should own customer data.

tasks.title: Assign data owner, steward and custodian roles to six people in a hospital scenario and justify each assignment
Choose centralised, federated or hybrid governance for a large college with five faculties and defend the trade-offs
Query a sample bank database to count duplicate customers and failed reconciliations and convert the numbers into an annual cost of poor data

schedule.title: Policies, maturity and strategy
schedule.exercise: Write a RACI chart for approving a new data field, assess an organisation on a five-level maturity model, and draft a one-page case for a governance programme.

tasks.title: Complete a RACI chart for a data-access request from a sample process and spot where no one is accountable
Rate an organisation on six governance capabilities from interview evidence and plot a maturity profile with the biggest gaps first
Select governance initiatives within a limited budget in a case, estimate benefit and cost for each, and argue the portfolio to the board

schedule.title: Master data and entity resolution
schedule.exercise: Merge three customer lists from a bank, a telecom and a retailer into one golden record per person, defining match rules, survivorship rules and a review band for uncertain matches.

tasks.title: Create a reference table of region codes, join it to a transactions table, and list rows with invalid or retired codes
Write SQL that groups customer records by normalised name and phone, picks a surviving record per group, and counts merged rows
Match 200 messy customer records using blocking and a similarity threshold, then compute precision and recall against the true links

schedule.title: Quality dimensions, profiling and rules
schedule.exercise: Profile a patient registration table for completeness, validity and uniqueness, write ten quality rules in SQL, and report the failing percentage for each.

tasks.title: Profile a customer table for null rates, distinct counts and value patterns on every column and summarise the findings
Write constraints and ten SQL checks for a patient table, then run them and report the percentage of failing rows per rule
Map each of six data quality problems in a sample dataset to a dimension and compute a weighted overall quality score

schedule.title: Cleansing, lineage and quality management
schedule.exercise: Trace a wrong revenue figure on a dashboard back through three transformations to its source, and set up a quality KPI with threshold and escalation path.

tasks.title: Remove duplicate rows from a contacts table with SQL, keeping the most recent per person, and show counts before and after
Draw column-level lineage for a dashboard figure through three SQL views and mark the transformation that introduced the error
Work a quality incident case: find the root cause across three systems, assign a fix owner, and define the KPI that proves the fix

schedule.title: Privacy principles and the legal landscape
schedule.exercise: Compare how the Ghanaian law and the EU regulation treat consent and data subject rights, and decide which lawful basis fits a clinic sending appointment reminders.

tasks.title: Match ten data practices in a loan app to the privacy principle each violates or satisfies, with a reason for each
Handle a data subject access request in a case: verify the person, find the data across systems, and respond within the deadline
Advise a fintech operating in Ghana and Kenya on which obligations differ between the two laws, scoring your advice against a rubric

schedule.title: Privacy by design, de-identification and breaches
schedule.exercise: Run a privacy impact assessment for a school-attendance app, de-identify a sample table, check k-anonymity, and draft a breach notification timeline.

tasks.title: Replace names and phone numbers in a table with pseudonyms, keep a separate mapping table, and confirm joins still work
Generalise age and postcode in a health table until every combination appears at least 5 times and report the information lost
Manage a data breach case: contain, assess harm, decide whom to notify and when, and justify the cross-border transfer questions

schedule.title: Records, retention and disposal
schedule.exercise: Draft a retention schedule for six record types in a hospital, decide how a legal hold suspends deletion, and estimate the storage saved by archiving and disposal.

tasks.title: Assign retention periods to eight record types from a given regulatory table and explain the trigger for each period
Write SQL that flags rows past their retention date, excludes those under legal hold, and moves the rest to an archive table
Compare the five-year cost of keeping all data online versus tiering by age, and judge the saving against retrieval delays

schedule.title: Metadata, dictionaries and catalogues
schedule.exercise: Create a business glossary entry and data dictionary rows for five fields, and sketch a catalogue workflow that keeps stewards' descriptions current.

tasks.title: Write dictionary entries for the columns of a loans table with definition, type, owner and sample values
Query the information schema to list every table and column with its type and nullability and store the result as a catalogue table
Design a catalogue architecture showing harvesting, search, stewardship workflow and lineage, and mark where manual effort remains

schedule.title: Classification and metadata standards
schedule.exercise: Classify twenty columns by sensitivity, describe a public health dataset with DCAT fields, and score it against the four FAIR principles.

tasks.title: Tag columns in a sample database as public, internal, confidential or restricted using name patterns and review the misses
Build a catalogue view showing each table's columns with sensitivity class and steward, then query for all restricted columns
Score a published dataset against FAIR criteria, list what is missing in its metadata, and write the fixes in priority order

schedule.title: Governing analytics and model risk
schedule.exercise: Tier five models in a lender's inventory by impact, set validation requirements for each tier, and compute approval-rate gaps for a credit score across two groups.

tasks.title: Place six models in risk tiers by decision impact and data sensitivity and list the validation each tier needs
Approve or reject a model release in a case by checking its documentation, validation results and monitoring plan
Compute approval rates and false negative rates by group for a scored loan table and judge whether a disparity needs action

schedule.title: Documenting models, responsible AI and data sharing
schedule.exercise: Write a model card and dataset datasheet for a clinic-triage model, and draft the clauses of a data sharing agreement with a research partner.

tasks.title: Fill in a model card from given facts about purpose, data, metrics and limits, and mark what is still unknown
Choose the clauses for a data sharing agreement between a hospital and a research team from a clause bank, with justification
Rule on a request to deploy a face-matching system in a case, weighing responsible AI policy, law, benefits and risks

schedule.title: Programme design, access control and audit
schedule.exercise: Present a twelve-month governance roadmap for a regional hospital group, showing quick wins, owners, access rules and how compliance will be audited.

tasks.title: Create roles and grant read access so a nurse sees only her ward's patients, then test with queries as each role
Query an access log table to find users who read records outside their role and summarise the findings for an auditor
Design and defend a governance roadmap for a bank in a scenario, balancing quick wins, regulator deadlines and limited staff
